profile.headline: Java / Scala Software Engineer, AWS, GCP
profile.summary:
• Seasoned developer with 10+ years java full stack development experience
* 5+ years cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP)
* Experience developing microservices using Dropwizard, Spring Boot, and Akka HTTP
• Experience developing web-based and backend applications using Spring Framework
• Experience integrating 3rd party applications (Salesforce, Tableau, Jive, Avalara, Google Search Appliance, Equifax)
• Conversant with Agile development framework following SCRUM & Kanban methodology
• Experience setting up Continuous Integration Environment using Maven, Jenkins, Nexus, & SCM (Git, Perforce, SVN)
• Goal oriented team player and highly motivated with ability to learn new technologies very quickly

Specialties:
Java, Scala, Spring Framework, Dropwizard, Akka HTTP, Hibernate
REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, Microservices
Kafka, RabbitMQ
Javascript, Node.js, React
Google Cloud Platform, Amazon AWS, Heroku, OpenStack
Kubernetes, Docker
Elastic Search, SOLR, ELK
Tomcat, Jetty, JBoss, Weblogic
Postgres, MySQL, Redis, DynamoDB, Oracle, MS SQL Server, MongoDB
Maven, Jenkins, Nexus, Git (Github/Gitlab), JIRA
Intellij
Salesforce, New Relic, Nagios, Twilio, Voicebase, Avalara, Jive

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI
positions.description: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · TypeScript · React.js · NestJS · OpenAI · Amazon Bedrock · Anthropic

positions.title: Software Engineer - Business Systems
positions.description:
*  Developed tax gateway service from Salesforce to Avalara for all transactions (domestic/international).
*  Developed content feed service which supplies content from Tableau web properties to google search appliance.
*  Load tested google search appliance and validated it can handle 30x load prior to company IPO using grinder.
*  Built out continuous integration environment which allows NetOps to deploy rpms from nexus over to production via yum using maven, jenkins, nexus, and git.
*  Developed beta invite tool from Salesforce which allows beta users access to private beta forums.  Used in 8.0, 8.1, & 8.2 beta.
*  Developed Salesforce/Tableau integration using force.com canvas, spring, and heroku.  Collaborated with marketing to build out demo site and deployed integrated solution internally.
*  Demonstrated Tableau dashboards can render real-time Salesforce data using heroku connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
*  Built out continuous integration environment using maven, jenkins, nexus, git, and bash.
*  Scaled out ActiveMQ instance from single to multi-node.
*  Developed log4j UDP appender to integrate with statsd.
*  Implemented client adapter to integrate with Amazon S3.
*  Developed batch processor to handle Equifax data appends.

positions.title: Expert Engineer
positions.description:
*  Developed retail storefront which integrates with Digital Commerce Suite.
*  Ported Digital Commerce Suite to Amazon AWS environment.
*  Developed scripts to automate the process of configuring and deploying Digital Commerce Suite.
*  Implemented multi-node solution for Digital Commerce Suite.
*  Developed web-based REST tool to interact with Digital Commerce Suite REST services.
